reviews.review_title: A game-changer for instant replays in VR
reviews.review_description: The maker of QGO has once again created an absolutely *invaluable* tool for VR players.  How often have we been engaged in a game, and something cool happens, something we wish we could show off to our friends?  An impressive shot in Walkabout Minigolf, a long rally in Racket Club, a hilarious line of dialog in Batman Arkham shadow - all those moments that pass in an instant and are impossible to reproduce.  Well now we can.  With XR Replay, the Quest is constantly recording the last few minutes of gameplay.  When something cool happens, we can just tell XR Replay to Save the most recent block of recording, and it shows up in our gallery.  It's like having a car's dashcam for our VR Headsets.
I love this developer! Best app for recording
A nice and easy app to record your gameplay.
